meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 它会扫描你的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源,检查区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测和多区域故障转移,生成一份按功能排列的检查表,并在你确认后按阶段做修复(CLI 命令或 IaC 补丁)。
howto.when: 当你提到「评估可靠性」「区域冗余」「单点故障」等关键词,或要求检查某个应用、资源组的可靠性时触发。仅覆盖 Azure Functions 和 App Service。

say.text: 评估我的函数应用可靠性,列出区域冗余和存储状态
say.note: 生成按功能排列的检查表

say.text: 帮我把这个应用服务计划改成区域冗余
say.note: 先给出修复方案,等你确认再执行

say.text: 检查这个资源组有没有单点故障
say.note: 只覆盖 Functions 和 App Service

howto.what_en: Scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover, builds a feature-pivoted checklist, then applies staged fixes (CLI commands or IaC patches) after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "single points of failure" and similar, or ask to check an app or resource group. Covers Functions and App Service only.

say_en.text: Assess my function app's reliability and show its zone and storage status
Make my app service plan zone redundant
say_en.note: Shows a fix plan and waits for your confirmation

say_en.text: Check this resource group for single points of failure
